feature: The New window makes an animated icon
summary: Typing something animated into the New window (an animated icon, an animated SVG, a GIF, a spinner) now makes a 512 by 512 icon that Ask draws and animates, ready to play and copy as a looping SVG, instead of 'Ask can't make videos yet.'. The Image sizes also gain Icon and App Icon, the same rows the New Image sheet has.
setup: Photonz Next, no switch changed from its default. Walks: ask-animates-from-the-new-window-walk (the user's own words), front-door-walk (the Icon row), ask-with-nothing-open-walk (a video still refused).

try.do: File > New, type 'make an animated trash can icon where it opens, some trash is thrown in' and click Create.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Wait for Ask: a 512 by 512 picture opens in Icon with the trash can, its lid and the trash keyed on the timeline.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Space: the lid swings open, the trash drops in, and it loops.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Edit > Copy SVG and paste it into a browser: it plays and loops (2026-11-07-new-window-animated-trash.svg is the walk's file).
Try 'an animated loading spinner' in a new New window: a spinner arc that turns and loops.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: Is an icon-sized square the picture you expected for 'a gif of a bouncing ball', or did you want something bigger?
Does 'a video camera icon' making an icon (not a refusal) match what you meant?
Is it clear while Ask works that the new window will move, before the first Play?
Do the Icon and App Icon rows at the end of the size list read as belonging there?
rough: Any animated request with no size or shape named is made at the Icon size (512 by 512) and drawn as a moving icon, so 'an animated sunset' is a moving icon, not a full scene. Chosen because the moving icon is what Ask animates well; logged in the task.
'moving' and 'spinning' alone do not ask for motion ('a moving van' and 'a spinning top' stay still pictures at the size picked); 'animated', 'animation', 'looping' and 'gif' do.
'a gif' makes an animated SVG; there is no GIF export to save it as a .gif from here.
The bouncing ball came out as a ring, not a solid ball: the model's drawing, not the route.
No mock covers the New window's size list (the user's call on 2026-10-22 replaced the front door mock's templates with Image or Video); the Icon rows follow the New Image sheet's list.

Held-out Ask eval not run again (about 2.4 hours): the change to Ask is routing only ('gif' asks for motion; motion asked of a blank icon draws a moving icon); the climb set's 12 animated cases all name 'icon' or 'svg' and route as before.
